mapper.select: WITH impression_raw AS ( SELECT DATE(i.created_at) AS dt, i.huagao_id, MAX(i.shangjia_id) AS shangjia_id, COUNT(*) AS impression_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN i.keyword IS NOT NULL AND i.keyword <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_impression_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN i.fenlei IS NOT NULL AND i.fenlei <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filter_fenlei_impression_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN i.tag_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filter_tag_impression_cnt FROM rec_huagao_impression_log i WHERE DATE(i.created_at) = #{dt} GROUP BY DATE(i.created_at), i.huagao_id ), action_raw AS ( SELECT DATE(a.created_at) AS dt, a.huagao_id, MAX(a.shangjia_id) AS shangjia_id, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'click_detail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_detail_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'detail_view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detail_view_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'detail_dwell' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detail_dwell_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'detail_dwell' THEN COALESCE(a.event_value, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS detail_dwell_total_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'favorite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS favorite_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS add_cart_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'create_order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS create_order_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'click_detail' AND COALESCE(r.has_search, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_click_detail_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'detail_view' AND COALESCE(r.has_search, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_detail_view_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'detail_dwell' AND COALESCE(r.has_search, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_detail_dwell_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'detail_dwell' AND COALESCE(r.has_search, 0) = 1 THEN COALESCE(a.event_value, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS search_detail_dwell_total_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'favorite' AND COALESCE(r.has_search, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_favorite_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'add_to_cart' AND COALESCE(r.has_search, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_add_cart_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'create_order' AND COALESCE(r.has_search, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_create_order_cnt FROM rec_huagao_action_log a LEFT JOIN rec_huagao_request_log r ON r.request_id = a.request_id WHERE DATE(a.created_at) = #{dt} GROUP BY DATE(a.created_at), a.huagao_id ), keyset AS ( SELECT dt, huagao_id FROM impression_raw UNION SELECT dt, huagao_id FROM action_raw UNION SELECT dt, huagao_id FROM rec_huagao_item_stat_daily WHERE dt = #{dt} ) SELECT k.dt, k.huagao_id, COALESCE(d.shangjia_id, i.shangjia_id, a.shangjia_id) AS shangjia_id, COALESCE(i.impression_cnt, 0) AS raw_impression_cnt, COALESCE(d.impression_cnt, 0) AS agg_impression_cnt, COALESCE(a.click_detail_cnt, 0) AS raw_click_detail_cnt, COALESCE(d.click_detail_cnt, 0) AS agg_click_detail_cnt, COALESCE(a.detail_view_cnt, 0) AS raw_detail_view_cnt, COALESCE(d.detail_view_cnt, 0) AS agg_detail_view_cnt, COALESCE(a.detail_dwell_cnt, 0) AS raw_detail_dwell_cnt, COALESCE(d.detail_dwell_cnt, 0) AS agg_detail_dwell_cnt, COALESCE(a.detail_dwell_total_ms, 0) AS raw_detail_dwell_total_ms, COALESCE(d.detail_dwell_total_ms, 0) AS agg_detail_dwell_total_ms, COALESCE(a.favorite_cnt, 0) AS raw_favorite_cnt, COALESCE(d.favorite_cnt, 0) AS agg_favorite_cnt, COALESCE(a.add_cart_cnt, 0) AS raw_add_cart_cnt, COALESCE(d.add_cart_cnt, 0) AS agg_add_cart_cnt, COALESCE(a.create_order_cnt, 0) AS raw_create_order_cnt, COALESCE(d.create_order_cnt, 0) AS agg_create_order_cnt, COALESCE(i.search_impression_cnt, 0) AS raw_search_impression_cnt, COALESCE(d.search_impression_cnt, 0) AS agg_search_impression_cnt, COALESCE(i.filter_fenlei_impression_cnt, 0) AS raw_filter_fenlei_impression_cnt, COALESCE(d.filter_fenlei_impression_cnt, 0) AS agg_filter_fenlei_impression_cnt, COALESCE(i.filter_tag_impression_cnt, 0) AS raw_filter_tag_impression_cnt, COALESCE(d.filter_tag_impression_cnt, 0) AS agg_filter_tag_impression_cnt, COALESCE(a.search_click_detail_cnt, 0) AS raw_search_click_detail_cnt, COALESCE(d.search_click_detail_cnt, 0) AS agg_search_click_detail_cnt, COALESCE(a.search_detail_view_cnt, 0) AS raw_search_detail_view_cnt, COALESCE(d.search_detail_view_cnt, 0) AS agg_search_detail_view_cnt, COALESCE(a.search_detail_dwell_cnt, 0) AS raw_search_detail_dwell_cnt, COALESCE(d.search_detail_dwell_cnt, 0) AS agg_search_detail_dwell_cnt, COALESCE(a.search_detail_dwell_total_ms, 0) AS raw_search_detail_dwell_total_ms, COALESCE(d.search_detail_dwell_total_ms, 0) AS agg_search_detail_dwell_total_ms, COALESCE(a.search_favorite_cnt, 0) AS raw_search_favorite_cnt, COALESCE(d.search_favorite_cnt, 0) AS agg_search_favorite_cnt, COALESCE(a.search_add_cart_cnt, 0) AS raw_search_add_cart_cnt, COALESCE(d.search_add_cart_cnt, 0) AS agg_search_add_cart_cnt, COALESCE(a.search_create_order_cnt, 0) AS raw_search_create_order_cnt, COALESCE(d.search_create_order_cnt, 0) AS agg_search_create_order_cnt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.impression_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.impression_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.click_detail_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.click_detail_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.detail_view_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.detail_view_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.detail_dwell_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.detail_dwell_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.detail_dwell_total_ms, 0) = COALESCE(d.detail_dwell_total_ms, 0) AND COALESCE(a.favorite_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.favorite_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.add_cart_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.add_cart_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.create_order_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.create_order_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(i.search_impression_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.search_impression_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(i.filter_fenlei_impression_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.filter_fenlei_impression_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(i.filter_tag_impression_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.filter_tag_impression_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.search_click_detail_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.search_click_detail_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.search_detail_view_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.search_detail_view_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.search_detail_dwell_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.search_detail_dwell_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.search_detail_dwell_total_ms, 0) = COALESCE(d.search_detail_dwell_total_ms, 0) AND COALESCE(a.search_favorite_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.search_favorite_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.search_add_cart_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.search_add_cart_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(a.search_create_order_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.search_create_order_cnt, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_match FROM keyset k LEFT JOIN impression_raw i ON i.dt = k.dt AND i.huagao_id = k.huagao_id LEFT JOIN action_raw a ON a.dt = k.dt AND a.huagao_id = k.huagao_id LEFT JOIN rec_huagao_item_stat_daily d ON d.dt = k.dt AND d.huagao_id = k.huagao_id ORDER BY is_match ASC, k.huagao_id ASC

WITH request_raw AS ( SELECT DATE(r.created_at) AS dt, r.query_key, MAX(r.scene) AS scene, MAX(r.keyword) AS keyword, MAX(r.normalized_keyword) AS normalized_keyword, MAX(r.fenlei) AS fenlei, MAX(r.tag_id) AS tag_id, MAX(r.has_search) AS has_search, MAX(r.has_fenlei_filter) AS has_fenlei_filter, MAX(r.has_tag_filter) AS has_tag_filter, COUNT(*) AS request_cnt FROM rec_huagao_request_log r WHERE DATE(r.created_at) = #{dt} GROUP BY DATE(r.created_at), r.query_key ), impression_raw AS ( SELECT DATE(i.created_at) AS dt, r.query_key, COUNT(*) AS impression_cnt FROM rec_huagao_impression_log i INNER JOIN rec_huagao_request_log r ON r.request_id = i.request_id WHERE DATE(i.created_at) = #{dt} GROUP BY DATE(i.created_at), r.query_key ), action_raw AS ( SELECT DATE(a.created_at) AS dt, r.query_key, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'click_detail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_detail_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'detail_view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detail_view_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'detail_dwell' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detail_dwell_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'detail_dwell' THEN COALESCE(a.event_value, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS detail_dwell_total_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'favorite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS favorite_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS add_cart_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.event_type = 'create_order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS create_order_cnt FROM rec_huagao_action_log a INNER JOIN rec_huagao_request_log r ON r.request_id = a.request_id WHERE DATE(a.created_at) = #{dt} GROUP BY DATE(a.created_at), r.query_key ), keyset AS ( SELECT dt, query_key FROM request_raw UNION SELECT dt, query_key FROM impression_raw UNION SELECT dt, query_key FROM action_raw UNION SELECT dt, query_key FROM rec_huagao_query_stat_daily WHERE dt = #{dt} ) SELECT k.dt, k.query_key, COALESCE(d.scene, rq.scene) AS scene, COALESCE(d.keyword, rq.keyword) AS keyword, COALESCE(d.normalized_keyword, rq.normalized_keyword) AS normalized_keyword, COALESCE(d.fenlei, rq.fenlei) AS fenlei, COALESCE(d.tag_id, rq.tag_id) AS tag_id, COALESCE(rq.request_cnt, 0) AS raw_request_cnt, COALESCE(d.request_cnt, 0) AS agg_request_cnt, COALESCE(ir.impression_cnt, 0) AS raw_impression_cnt, COALESCE(d.impression_cnt, 0) AS agg_impression_cnt, COALESCE(ar.click_detail_cnt, 0) AS raw_click_detail_cnt, COALESCE(d.click_detail_cnt, 0) AS agg_click_detail_cnt, COALESCE(ar.detail_view_cnt, 0) AS raw_detail_view_cnt, COALESCE(d.detail_view_cnt, 0) AS agg_detail_view_cnt, COALESCE(ar.detail_dwell_cnt, 0) AS raw_detail_dwell_cnt, COALESCE(d.detail_dwell_cnt, 0) AS agg_detail_dwell_cnt, COALESCE(ar.detail_dwell_total_ms, 0) AS raw_detail_dwell_total_ms, COALESCE(d.detail_dwell_total_ms, 0) AS agg_detail_dwell_total_ms, COALESCE(ar.favorite_cnt, 0) AS raw_favorite_cnt, COALESCE(d.favorite_cnt, 0) AS agg_favorite_cnt, COALESCE(ar.add_cart_cnt, 0) AS raw_add_cart_cnt, COALESCE(d.add_cart_cnt, 0) AS agg_add_cart_cnt, COALESCE(ar.create_order_cnt, 0) AS raw_create_order_cnt, COALESCE(d.create_order_cnt, 0) AS agg_create_order_cnt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(rq.request_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.request_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(ir.impression_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.impression_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(ar.click_detail_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.click_detail_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(ar.detail_view_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.detail_view_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(ar.detail_dwell_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.detail_dwell_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(ar.detail_dwell_total_ms, 0) = COALESCE(d.detail_dwell_total_ms, 0) AND COALESCE(ar.favorite_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.favorite_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(ar.add_cart_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.add_cart_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(ar.create_order_cnt, 0) = COALESCE(d.create_order_cnt, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_match FROM keyset k LEFT JOIN request_raw rq ON rq.dt = k.dt AND rq.query_key = k.query_key LEFT JOIN impression_raw ir ON ir.dt = k.dt AND ir.query_key = k.query_key LEFT JOIN action_raw ar ON ar.dt = k.dt AND ar.query_key = k.query_key LEFT JOIN rec_huagao_query_stat_daily d ON d.dt = k.dt AND d.query_key = k.query_key ORDER BY is_match ASC, k.query_key ASC

SELECT r.request_id, r.scene, r.user_id, r.visitor_id, r.session_id, r.keyword, r.normalized_keyword, r.fenlei, r.tag_id, r.page_no, r.page_size, r.sort_mode, r.has_search, r.has_fenlei_filter, r.has_tag_filter, i.huagao_id, i.shangjia_id, i.position, i.search_score, i.created_at AS impression_at, COALESCE(a.click_detail_cnt, 0) AS click_detail_cnt, COALESCE(a.detail_view_cnt, 0) AS detail_view_cnt, COALESCE(a.detail_dwell_cnt, 0) AS detail_dwell_cnt, COALESCE(a.detail_dwell_total_ms, 0) AS detail_dwell_total_ms, COALESCE(a.favorite_cnt, 0) AS favorite_cnt, COALESCE(a.add_cart_cnt, 0) AS add_cart_cnt, COALESCE(a.create_order_cnt, 0) AS create_order_cnt, a.first_click_detail_at, a.first_detail_view_at, a.first_favorite_at, a.first_add_to_cart_at, a.first_create_order_at, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.create_order_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 4 WHEN COALESCE(a.add_cart_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 3 WHEN COALESCE(a.favorite_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(a.click_detail_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS relevance, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.create_order_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 'create_order' WHEN COALESCE(a.add_cart_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 'add_to_cart' WHEN COALESCE(a.favorite_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 'favorite' WHEN COALESCE(a.click_detail_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 'click_detail' ELSE 'impression' END AS label_source FROM rec_huagao_request_log r INNER JOIN rec_huagao_impression_log i ON i.request_id = r.request_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT request_id, huagao_id, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'click_detail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_detail_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'detail_view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detail_view_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'detail_dwell' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detail_dwell_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'detail_dwell' THEN COALESCE(event_value, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS detail_dwell_total_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'favorite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS favorite_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS add_cart_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'create_order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS create_order_cnt, MIN(CASE WHEN event_type = 'click_detail' THEN created_at END) AS first_click_detail_at, MIN(CASE WHEN event_type = 'detail_view' THEN created_at END) AS first_detail_view_at, MIN(CASE WHEN event_type = 'favorite' THEN created_at END) AS first_favorite_at, MIN(CASE WHEN event_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN created_at END) AS first_add_to_cart_at, MIN(CASE WHEN event_type = 'create_order' THEN created_at END) AS first_create_order_at FROM rec_huagao_action_log GROUP BY request_id, huagao_id ) a ON a.request_id = i.request_id AND a.huagao_id = i.huagao_id WHERE DATE(r.created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, i.position ASC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH request_scope AS ( SELECT * FROM rec_huagao_request_log WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} ), impression_scope AS ( SELECT * FROM rec_huagao_impression_log WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} ), action_scope AS ( SELECT * FROM rec_huagao_action_log WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} ), action_summary AS ( SELECT request_id, huagao_id, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'click_detail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_detail_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'favorite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS favorite_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS add_cart_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'create_order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS create_order_cnt FROM action_scope GROUP BY request_id, huagao_id ), sample_scope AS ( SELECT r.request_id, i.huagao_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.create_order_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 4 WHEN COALESCE(a.add_cart_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 3 WHEN COALESCE(a.favorite_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(a.click_detail_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS relevance FROM request_scope r INNER JOIN impression_scope i ON i.request_id = r.request_id LEFT JOIN action_summary a ON a.request_id = i.request_id AND a.huagao_id = i.huagao_id ) SELECT #{dateFrom} AS date_from, #{dateTo} AS date_to, (SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM request_scope) AS first_request_at, (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM request_scope) AS last_request_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM request_scope) AS request_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(created_at)) FROM request_scope) AS active_day_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT query_key) FROM request_scope) AS query_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM request_scope) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) FROM request_scope) AS visitor_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM request_scope) AS session_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('u:', user_id) WHEN visitor_id IS NOT NULL AND visitor_id <> '' THEN CONCAT('v:', visitor_id) ELSE NULL END) FROM request_scope) AS actor_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(has_search) FROM request_scope), 0) AS search_request_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(has_fenlei_filter) FROM request_scope), 0) AS fenlei_filter_request_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(has_tag_filter) FROM request_scope), 0) AS tag_filter_request_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(returned_count) FROM request_scope), 0) AS returned_item_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM impression_scope) AS impression_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT huagao_id) FROM impression_scope) AS huagao_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM action_scope) AS action_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sample_scope) AS sample_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sample_scope WHERE relevance > 0) AS positive_sample_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT relevance) FROM sample_scope) AS label_level_count

WITH action_summary AS ( SELECT request_id, huagao_id, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'click_detail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_detail_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'favorite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS favorite_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS add_cart_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'create_order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS create_order_cnt FROM rec_huagao_action_log WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} GROUP BY request_id, huagao_id ), sample_scope AS ( SELECT r.request_id, i.huagao_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.create_order_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 4 WHEN COALESCE(a.add_cart_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 3 WHEN COALESCE(a.favorite_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(a.click_detail_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS relevance, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.create_order_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 'create_order' WHEN COALESCE(a.add_cart_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 'add_to_cart' WHEN COALESCE(a.favorite_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 'favorite' WHEN COALESCE(a.click_detail_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 'click_detail' ELSE 'impression' END AS label_source FROM rec_huagao_request_log r INNER JOIN rec_huagao_impression_log i ON i.request_id = r.request_id LEFT JOIN action_summary a ON a.request_id = i.request_id AND a.huagao_id = i.huagao_id WHERE DATE(r.created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} ) SELECT relevance, label_source, COUNT(*) AS sample_count, COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) AS request_count, COUNT(DISTINCT huagao_id) AS huagao_count FROM sample_scope GROUP BY relevance, label_source ORDER BY relevance ASC

SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) AS request_count, COUNT(DISTINCT huagao_id) AS huagao_count, COALESCE(SUM(event_value), 0) AS event_value_total FROM rec_huagao_action_log WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY event_count DESC, event_type ASC

WITH request_daily AS ( SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS request_count, SUM(has_search) AS search_request_count FROM rec_huagao_request_log WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ), impression_daily AS ( SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS impression_count, COUNT(DISTINCT huagao_id) AS huagao_count FROM rec_huagao_impression_log WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ), action_daily AS ( SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS action_count FROM rec_huagao_action_log WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ), action_summary AS ( SELECT request_id, huagao_id, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'click_detail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_detail_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'favorite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS favorite_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS add_cart_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'create_order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS create_order_cnt FROM rec_huagao_action_log WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} GROUP BY request_id, huagao_id ), sample_daily AS ( SELECT DATE(r.created_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS sample_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.create_order_cnt, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(a.add_cart_cnt, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(a.favorite_cnt, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(a.click_detail_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_sample_count FROM rec_huagao_request_log r INNER JOIN rec_huagao_impression_log i ON i.request_id = r.request_id LEFT JOIN action_summary a ON a.request_id = i.request_id AND a.huagao_id = i.huagao_id WHERE DATE(r.created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} GROUP BY DATE(r.created_at) ), keyset AS ( SELECT dt FROM request_daily UNION SELECT dt FROM impression_daily UNION SELECT dt FROM action_daily UNION SELECT dt FROM sample_daily ) SELECT k.dt, COALESCE(r.request_count, 0) AS request_count, COALESCE(r.search_request_count, 0) AS search_request_count, COALESCE(i.impression_count, 0) AS impression_count, COALESCE(i.huagao_count, 0) AS huagao_count, COALESCE(a.action_count, 0) AS action_count, COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS sample_count, COALESCE(s.positive_sample_count, 0) AS positive_sample_count FROM keyset k LEFT JOIN request_daily r ON r.dt = k.dt LEFT JOIN impression_daily i ON i.dt = k.dt LEFT JOIN action_daily a ON a.dt = k.dt LEFT JOIN sample_daily s ON s.dt = k.dt ORDER BY k.dt ASC

SELECT 'impression_without_request' AS check_key, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM rec_huagao_impression_log i LEFT JOIN rec_huagao_request_log r ON r.request_id = i.request_id WHERE DATE(i.created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} AND r.request_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'action_without_request' AS check_key, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM rec_huagao_action_log a LEFT JOIN rec_huagao_request_log r ON r.request_id = a.request_id WHERE DATE(a.created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} AND a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND r.request_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'action_without_impression' AS check_key, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM rec_huagao_action_log a LEFT JOIN rec_huagao_impression_log i ON i.request_id = a.request_id AND i.huagao_id = a.huagao_id WHERE DATE(a.created_at) BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} AND a.request_id IS NOT NULL AND i.id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'request_without_identity' AS check_key, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM rec_huagao_request_log r WHERE
